rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Market Day: i-pop ejabulisayo ku-G enesigqi se-highlife, umculo wesiginci okhanyayo waseNtshonalanga Afrika. Ibinzana layo elihehayo lisebenzisa amanothi e-G major kuphela, lingene ku-scale yakho yendawo yesibili. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Ama-chord e-Market Day ngu-G, B minor, C no-D. Akuziphi izinombolo ze-scale?
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: U-G ungu-1, B ungu-3, C ungu-4, D ungu-5. I-chord eku-3 iyi-minor kuwo wonke ukhiye we-major: B minor.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 20 · lesson gtr-20-spotlight “Song spotlight: Market Day” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D ku-fret 3 entanjeni 2, B ku-fret 4 entanjeni 3, D futhi, E ku-fret 5 ngomunwe 4, bese D no-B.

rows.translation: Akukho okusha: G major kuma-octave amabili, i-scale ngama-interval esithathu, A Dorian no-D Mixolydian. Gcina umunwe owodwa ku-fret ngayinye.

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: I-major pentatonic, ama-hammer-on nokushelela kwe-country, ama-trill, amabinzana, nomsindo omnandi nomuncu ku-blues.

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Hambisa i-box ye-minor pentatonic usuke ku-fret 5 wehlele ku-fret 2, uthathe u-A njengesisekelo: umsindo uba mnandi, ube yi-major. Leyo yi-A major pentatonic: A, B, C ophakanyisiwe, E no-F ophakanyisiwe.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Kusuka ku-A entanjeni 6, ku-fret 5, bese ama-fret 2 no-4 ezintanjeni 5 no-4, no-A ku-fret 2 entanjeni 3.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.translation: A, B, C ophakanyisiwe, E, F ophakanyisiwe
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Amanothi amahlanu e-scale ye-A major, kushiywe ohhafu bethoni bayo ababili. I-box ye-minor ku-fret 5 ino-A, C, D, E no-G.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-1 “The major pentatonic” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Le box ku-fret 2 iphinde ibe yi-F ophakanyisiwe minor pentatonic uma iqala ku-F ophakanyisiwe. Inothi olithatha njengesisekelo yilo elinquma ukuthi udlala yiphi.

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Abadlali be-country bathanda ama-hammer-on kule box: E uye ku-F ophakanyisiwe entanjeni 4, A uye ku-B entanjeni 3. Ncinza inothi lokuqala, wenze i-hammer-on kwelesibili.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Intambo 4: ncinza ku-fret 2, bese wehlisa umunwe 3 ku-fret 4 nge-hammer-on.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Manje shelelisa umunwe 3 entanjeni 3 usuke ku-fret 4 uye ku-fret 6, u-B ukhuphukele ku-C ophakanyisiwe, bese ushelela ubuyele ku-box.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Umunwe 3 entanjeni 3, ku-fret 4. Ncinza, bese ushelela uye ku-fret 6 ungawuphakamisi.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-2 “Country hammer-ons and slides” · step 5 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: I-trill ishintshana phakathi kwamanothi amabili: uncinza kanye, bese i-hammer-on, i-pull-off, ukuphindaphinde. Kwenze kulingane ngaphambi kokukusheshisa.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-3 “Trills and slides into notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Intambo 3: ama-fret 2 no-4. Ncinza kanye, bese wenza i-hammer-on ne-pull-off ngomunwe 3.

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Qala nge-fret eyodwa ngaphansi kwenothi olifunayo, ushelele ukhuphukele kulo lapho uncinza. Inothi elihlosiwe yilo elibalulekile: fika kulo ngqo esigqini.

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Uma ushelela ungene enothini, yiliphi elifika esigqini?

rows.translation: Ukushelela kuqala ngaphambi nje kwesigqi, ukuze inothi olihlosile lifike ngqo kuso.

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Phezu kwe-blues ku-A, womabili ama-box ayasebenza. I-major pentatonic ku-fret 2 izwakala imnandi; i-minor ku-fret 5 izwakala iqinile. Abadlali abahle bashintshana phakathi kwawo.

rows.translation: Iyiphi i-box ezwakala imnandi kakhulu phezu kwe-A7?

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: I-major pentatonic ino-C ophakanyisiwe, inothi lesithathu lika-A7. U-C we-box ye-minor uphikisana naye, futhi yilokho kungqubuzana okuyi-blues.

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Buza umbuzo onamandla ku-fret 5, bese uphendula ngobumnandi ku-fret 2. Hambisa isandla enothini elide, uphethe womabili amabinzana ngo-A.

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Ama-solo amahle ayaphefumula. Dlala ibinzana elifushane, uphumule isikhathi esicishe silingane nalo, bese uphendula. Ukuthula kwenza amanothi alandelayo abe nesisindo.

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Dlala ibinzana kabili ngendlela efanayo, bese ushintsha isiphetho salo kuphela. Abalaleli bezwa ukuphinda, balinde ushintsho.

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Bamba inothi ngalinye elide, ulinyakazise ngokuphusha nokudedela okuncane, okulinganayo. Kwenze kube kuncane: ukuphakama komsindo makuntengantenge, kungaphambuki.

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Slow Motion Strobe: i-synth-pop ku-A, ngo-F ophakanyisiwe minor, D, A no-E. I-box yakho ku-fret 2 ihambisana nalo lonke uchungechunge: A major pentatonic, nayo eyi-F ophakanyisiwe minor pentatonic. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 21 · lesson gtr-21-spotlight “Song spotlight: Slow Motion Strobe” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Lalela i-chord yokuqala. I-major noma i-minor?

rows.translation: U-E ungu-E, G ophakanyisiwe no-B. I-box ino-E no-B kodwa ayinaye u-G ophakanyisiwe, ngakho gcizelela labo ababili phezu kuka-E.

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Izingoma eziningi zakhiwa yizingxenye ezimbalwa: amavesi axoxa indaba, ikhorasi ephinda ibinzana elihehayo, kwesinye isikhathi ibhuloho elenza umehluko. Ukwazi uhlelo kukusiza ungalahleki.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Ikhorasi ibuya namagama nomculo ofanayo. Yiyona ngxenye abantu abayikhumbulayo abacula nayo.
rows.context: Guitar · Unit 22 · lesson gtr-22-1 “How songs are built” · step 2 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Izingoma eziningi zakudala zisebenzisa i-AABA: umculo, uphinde wona, ibhuloho elihlukile, bese umculo futhi. Ingxenye ngayinye ivame ukuthatha amabha ayisishiyagalombili; lapha ithatha amane.

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Isingeniso esilula kunazo zonke umugqa wokugcina wengoma, udlalwe ngaphambi kwevesi lokuqala. Simisa ukhiye, i-tempo nomuzwa, umculi azi kahle ukuthi ungena kuphi.

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Ukuze uphethe, phinda umugqa wokugcina, kuvame ukuba kabili futhi, uvumele i-chord yokugcina ikhale. Isiphetho esifushane sitshela bonke ukuthi ingoma iyaphela.

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Abahleli bezingoma baphakamisa ikhorasi ngokushintsha indlela isiginci esidlala ngayo. Dlala ivesi ngeminwe kancane, bese ushaya izintambo kukhorasi: ama-chord afanayo azwakala egcwele kakhulu.

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: I-Down by the Riverside, ingoma yenkolo yesintu eyashicilelwa okokuqala ngo-1918, siyihlela ngokugcwele: isingeniso ngendlela ka-Travis, amavesi namakhorasi amabili, i-solo ye-pentatonic nesiphetho esifushane.

rows.translation: Timbre iqambe i-Jukebox Moon: umdanso ohamba kancane wesitayela samashumi amahlanu, nge-AABA. Ivesi, ivesi futhi, ibhuloho ku-F, bese ivesi futhi. Shaya isigqi ngasinye, ukhuphuke masinyane nge-swing ngaphambi kwebha ngayinye. Ingoma yonke iku-Izingoma, ngaphansi kwe-Izingoma zokuqala.

rows.source: Hold it, meet G C E A, play your first notes, your first chord and a song.
rows.translation: Yibambe, wazi u-G C E A, udlale amanothi akho okuqala, i-chord yakho yokuqala nengoma.

rows.source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
rows.translation: Sekela umzimba wayo esifubeni, intamo ibheke kwesokunxele. Intambo eseduze kakhulu naphansi yintambo 1. Inenothi elivulekile eliphakeme kakhulu.

rows.source: From string 4 down to string 1, the open strings are G, C, E, A. Try: Good Cooks Eat Apples.
rows.translation: Kusuka entanjeni 4 kwehle kuye ku-1, izintambo ezivulekile zingu-G, C, E, A. Khumbula ngezinhlamvu zokuqala: Good Cooks Eat Apples.

rows.source: Play strings 4 and 3, one at a time.

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Ezinsimbini eziningi, umsindo wezintambo uya ngokuya wehla njengoba ukhuphuka. Ku-ukulele, intambo 4 (G) iphakeme kunentambo 3 (C). Lokhu kubizwa ngokushuna kwe-re-entrant.

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: U-G ophakeme ugcina amanothi e-chord ngayinye esondelene, enomsindo okhanyayo. Yilowo msindo omnandi, onkenenezayo abantu abawazi njenge-ukulele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
rows.translation: Intambo 3, bese kuba ngu-4. Uyakuzwa ukugxumela phezulu?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-1-3 “The high G string” · step 4 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which open string plays the lowest note?
rows.translation: Iyiphi intambo evulekile enenothi eliphansi kakhulu?

rows.source: With re-entrant tuning, C on string 3 is the lowest note on the ukulele.
rows.translation: Ekushuneni kwe-re-entrant, u-C entanjeni 3 uyinothi eliphansi kakhulu ku-ukulele.

rows.translation: Evulekile, i-fret 2, i-fret 3: A, B, C.

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3 is D. Fret 1 on string 2 is F. Fret 3 on string 2 is G, the same note as open string 4.
rows.translation: I-fret 2 entanjeni 3 ingu-D. I-fret 1 entanjeni 2 ingu-F. I-fret 3 entanjeni 2 ingu-G, inothi elifana nentambo 4 evulekile.

rows.translation: I-fret 3 entanjeni 2 ifana nayiphi intambo evulekile?

rows.source: Both are G. Two places, one note.
rows.translation: Womabili angu-G. Izindawo ezimbili, inothi elilodwa.

rows.source: Open strings, the high G and your first fretted notes. Take it slowly and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Izintambo ezivulekile, u-G ophakeme namanothi akho okuqala acindezelwe. Dlala kancane, uyeke inothi ngalinye likhale.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Name the open strings from 4 to 1.
rows.translation: Yisho amagama ezintambo ezivulekile kusuka ku-4 kuya ku-1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Which one is the open G string?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · challenge uke-1-6 “Challenge: first notes” · step 3 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Zonke izintambo ezine zivulekile, 4 kuya ku-1.

rows.source: Your fretted notes: D, F, B, C.
rows.translation: Amanothi akho acindezelwe: D, F, B, C.

rows.source: C uses your third finger on fret 3 of string 1. The other three strings ring open.
rows.translation: Ku-C, beka umunwe wesithathu ku-fret 3 wentambo 1. Ezinye izintambo ezintathu zikhala zivulekile.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Brush down across all four strings with the pad of your thumb, from string 4 to string 1. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Dlulisa ingxenye ethambile yesithupha yehle kuzo zonke izintambo ezine, kusuka ku-4 kuya ku-1. Isihlakala sikhululeke.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · lesson uke-2-1 “Your first chord: C” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
rows.translation: Umunwe wesithathu ufinyelela ku-fret 3 ngaphandle kokweluleka kakhulu.

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: I-Row, Row, Row Your Boat idinga u-C kuphela. Shaya izintambo ezigqini ezimbili ezinkulu zebha ngayinye, bese udlala umculo ezintanjeni 1 kuya ku-3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Amanothi amahlanu omculo: C no-D entanjeni 3, E, F no-G entanjeni 2.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 1 · song uke-1-7 “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A minor, F, G7 no-G: kanye no-C, ama-chord asetshenziswa ezingomeni eziningi kakhulu.

Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Beka umunwe wesibili ku-fret 2 wentambo 4, ushaye zonke izintambo ezine. I-A minor izwakala imnyama kuno-C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Phakamisa umunwe ongasawudingi, ubeke omusha izintambo zisakhala ekushayeni kokugcina. Lungela i-chord elandelayo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-2 “A minor and your first change” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Umunwe wokuqala ku-fret 1 wentambo 2, owesibili ku-fret 2 wentambo 4. Izintambo 3 no-1 zikhala zivulekile.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord ebeka umunwe endaweni efana neka-F?

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Kuzo zombili, umunwe wesibili uhlala ku-fret 2 wentambo 4. Ungawuphakamisi lapho ushintsha.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-3 “F: two fingers” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · title
Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Umunwe wokuqala ku-fret 1 wentambo 2, owesibili ku-fret 2 wentambo 3, owesithathu ku-fret 2 wentambo 1. Shaya zonke ezine.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: U-G7 uzwakala engakapheleli. Dlala u-C ngemva kwakhe, kudedele ukungazinzi. Lokho kudonseka yikho okwenza izingoma eziningi zibeke u-G7 ngaphambi kuka-C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Lokhu kuphelela ekhaya noma kukushiye ulindile?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 2 · lesson uke-2-4 “G7, the chord that leads home” · step 4 (listen) · question or instruction

rows.translation: Umunwe wokuqala ku-fret 2 wentambo 3, owesibili ku-fret 2 wentambo 1, owesithathu ku-fret 3 wentambo 2. Gobisa iminwe ukuze intambo 4 ikhale.

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Womabili ama-chord abeka umunwe ku-fret 2 wentambo 3. Sebenzisa le ndawo njengesisekelo sokushintsha.

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A minor, F, G7 no-G asetshenziswa emakhulwini ezingoma. Yenza isimo ngasinye sikhale kahle, bese ugcina isigqi lapho ushintsha.

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord esebenzisa umunwe owodwa kuphela?

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Ukushaya phansi ngokulinganayo, phansi-phezulu, nendlela ye-island.

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Shaya phansi esigqini ngasinye: 1, 2, 3, 4. Sebenzisa uzipho lomunwe wokukhomba. Lapho ushintsha ama-chord, isandla siqhubeka nokunyakaza.

rows.translation: Isandla sakho kufanele senzeni lapho ushintsha ama-chord?

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Kungcono i-chord ifike sekwephuzile kunokuba isigqi siphazamiseke. Qhubeka ushaye, ngisho noma intambo ikhenceza.

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Bala u-1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Shaya phansi ezinombolweni, phezulu ku-and ngamunye. Isandla sakho asiyeki ukunyakaza.

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Uma ushaya phezulu, uthinta kakhulu izintambo 1 no-2. Dlulisa ingxenye ethambile yomunwe kuzo, uthambise kancane kunalapho wehla.

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Phansi ku-1, phansi-phezulu ku-2, phansi ku-3, phansi-phezulu ku-4. Isandla sisakhuphuka ngemva kuka-1 no-3; simane singazithinti izintambo.

rows.translation: Ukukhuphuka okuthule kugcina isandla sakho esigqini sokwehla okulandelayo.

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: No-F ubeka umunwe 1 entanjeni 2, i-fret 1. Wugcine lapho ngesikhathi ushintsha.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-1 “B flat: a small barre” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · title

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Lalisa umunwe 1 phezu kwezintambo 4, 3 no-2 ku-fret 2, ubeke umunwe 2 entanjeni 1, i-fret 3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: Ku-G, ama-chord u-G, C no-D7 enza umsebenzi omningi, i-E minor ingeze umsindo omnyama. U-D7 udonsela ku-G ngendlela u-G7 adonsela ngayo ku-C.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-2 “D7 and the key of G” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Lalisa umunwe 1 phezu kwezintambo 3, 2 no-1 ku-fret 2, bese welula umunwe 3 uye entanjeni 4, i-fret 4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: U-D no-B minor bacindezela i-fret 2 kuziphi izintambo?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Womabili ama-chord abamba i-fret 2 ezintanjeni 3 no-2. Kushintsha izintambo zangaphandle kuphela.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: Ku-D, ama-chord u-D, G no-A7 ahambisana nengoma, i-B minor ingeze umuzwa wosizi. U-A7 usebenzisa umunwe owodwa: intambo 3, i-fret 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-3 “B minor and the key of D” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Ama-chord engoma ayizinyathelo zokhiye wayo: I, IV no-V. Shintsha ukhiye, izinombolo zisale. Ku-C kuba C, F no-G7; ku-G kube G, C no-D7; ku-F kube F, B owehlisiwe no-C7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Bala ukhuphuke usuka ku-F: F, G, A, B owehlisiwe. Inothi lesine ngu-B owehlisiwe.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Uma ingoma iphakeme noma iphansi kakhulu ukuba uyicule, iyise komunye ukhiye. Izinombolo ziyafana, ingoma iyafana, kodwa ilifanela kangcono izwi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Bala ukhuphuke usuka ku-D: D, E, F ophakanyisiwe, G, A. U-A uyinothi lesihlanu, ngakho i-A7 iyi-chord engu-V.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-4 “Same numbers, new key” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Umunwe 2 entanjeni 3, i-fret 2, umunwe 3 entanjeni 2, i-fret 3, nomunwe 1 entanjeni 1, i-fret 1. Intambo 4 ikhala ivulekile.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Umndeni we-D minor uhlanganisa D minor, G minor no-A7. U-A7 udonsela ekhaya ku-D minor, ngendlela u-E7 adonsela ngayo ku-A minor.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · lesson uke-7-5 “G minor and minor keys” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · title
Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: B owehlisiwe, D7, B minor no-G minor, nokhiye baka-C, G, F no-D. Qala ngezimo ezikhala kahle, bese ushaya ngokulinganayo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 7 · challenge uke-7-6 “Challenge: new keys” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · title

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: I-chunk, indlela ye-island ene-backbeat, i-swing nama-chord e-ragtime, ukugcizelela ngo-3-3-2, ne-waltz.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 “Strum styles” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: I-chunk ingukushaya okunqamuka ngokushesha. Shaya phansi, uhlangothi lwentende lufike ezintanjeni ngesikhathi esifanayo: ukunqakuza okufushane okomile, njengesigubhu se-snare.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Shaya phansi ku-1, i-chunk ku-2, phansi-phezulu ku-3, i-chunk ku-4. Ama-chunk afika lapho oshaya izigubhu eshaya khona i-snare.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 2 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Isigqi sesibili nesesine yi-backbeat, lapho kudlala khona isigubhu se-snare. I-chunk lapho inika ukushaya kwakho amandla esigubhu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-1 “The chunk” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · title

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Thatha indlela ye-island, D, DU, UDU, uguqule ukwehla ku-2 kube yi-chunk. Isigqi sihlala sinjalo; indlela yokudlala ithola i-backbeat.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Kulokhu kushaya, yikuphi ukunyakaza okuba yi-chunk?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Isigqi 1 siyakhala, isigqi 2 sinqakuze. Konke okunye kuhlala endaweni yako endleleni ye-island.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-2 “Island strum with a chunk” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · title

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: I-swing ihlukanisa isigqi ngasinye ngokungalingani: ukwehla okude, bese ukukhuphuka okufushane. Yisho u-hum-pty, dum-pty lapho ushaya. Yilokhu okudansisa imiculo emidala ye-ukulele.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7, bese ekhaya ku-C. I-chord ngayinye ye-seventh idonsela kwelandelayo, kwakheke uchungechunge oluncane lokungazinzi. Lokhu kwakusetshenziswa ezingomeni eziningi eminyakeni eyikhulu edlule.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: U-D7 uholela ku-G, u-G7 aholele ekhaya ku-C. I-chord ngayinye ilungiselela elandelayo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-3 “Swing and the ragtime chords” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Shaya ama-quaver ngokulinganayo, phansi-phezulu, kodwa ushaye amathathu ngamandla: 1, u-and ka-2, no-4. Phakathi kokugcizelela kuba nama-quaver angu-3, 3 no-2.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Bala u-1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 kuma-quaver ayisishiyagalombili ebha. U-1 ngamunye uyagcizelelwa.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: I-split stroke ka-George Formby ku-banjo ukulele ibeka ukushaya okukhulu kulezo zindawo ezintathu, inamanothi ezintambo ngazinye phakathi. Qala ufunde kahle ukugcizelela.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-4 “Accents in 3-3-2” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: Ezigqini ezintathu, shaya phansi ku-1, bese phansi-phezulu ku-2 naku-3: D, DU, DU. Gcizelela u-1 ukuze ukudansisa kuzwakale kahle.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Ushaya kangaki ukugcwalisa le bha yezigqi ezintathu?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Phansi ku-1, bese phansi-phezulu ku-2 naku-3: kanye, bese kabili, bese kabili.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · lesson uke-8-5 “Waltz strums” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · title
Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: ama-chunk, indlela ye-island ene-chunk, i-swing, ukugcizelela ngo-3-3-2 ne-waltz. Gcina isandla sinyakaza, ukugcizelela kuzwakale.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Ekushayeni nge-swing, isigqi ngasinye sihlukaniswa sibe…
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 8 · challenge uke-8-6 “Challenge: strum styles” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · title

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Umunwe wentambo ngayinye, amaphethini agelezayo, isithupha esishintshana nomculo oncinzwa phakathi kwama-chord awo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 “Fingerpicking and chord melody” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Beka isithupha entanjeni 4, umunwe wokukhomba ku-3, ophakathi ku-2 nowendandatho ku-1. Ngamunye uncinza intambo yawo kuphela.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Isithupha, owokukhomba, ophakathi, owendandatho: izintambo 4, 3, 2 no-1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Isithupha ku-4, owokukhomba ku-3, ophakathi ku-2, owendandatho ku-1: umunwe wentambo ngayinye.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 4 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Njengoba intambo 4 ingu-G ophakeme, iphethini iya phezulu, phansi, bese ikhuphuka. Lokho kukhanya ngumsindo we-ukulele edlalwa ngeminwe.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A minor, F, C, G7, ngama-quaver
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-1 “One finger per string” · step 7 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Ncinza izintambo 4, 3, 2 no-1, ubuye ngo-2 no-3: isithupha, owokukhomba, ophakathi, owendandatho, ophakathi, owokukhomba. Amanothi ayisithupha agcwalisa ibha yezigqi ezintathu.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Ngemva kokuba umunwe wendandatho uncinze intambo 1, kulandela muphi umunwe?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Iphethini ijika phezulu: owendandatho entanjeni 1, bese ophakathi ku-2, owokukhomba ku-3.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · title

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Bamba i-chord entsha lapho isithupha siqala ibha elandelayo. Iminwe iyaqhubeka nokugeleza; kushintsha isimo se-chord kuphela.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-2 “Rolling patterns” · step 5 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Manje isithupha sishintshana phakathi kwezintambo 3 no-4 ezigqini, iminwe incinze izintambo 2 no-1 phakathi kwazo. Yindlela ye-ukulele yokudlala kuka-Travis.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Isithupha sigcina isigqi, inothi esigqini ngasinye, iminwe igcwalise izikhala.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 5 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-3 “The alternating thumb” · step 6 (along) · title
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · title

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Ekudlaleni umculo phakathi kwama-chord, isandla esicindezelayo sibamba i-chord, wena uncinze umculo phakathi kwayo. Bamba u-F: u-C, F no-A sebevele bengaphansi kweminwe yakho.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Bamba u-F: intambo 3 evulekile, i-fret 1 wentambo 2, intambo 1 evulekile. I-Amazing Grace iqala kanjalo.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Uma umculo usuka emanothini e-chord, finyelela ngomunwe okhululekile. Ku-F, umunwe 3 udlala u-G entanjeni 2, i-fret 3, bese uphakama lapho umculo ubuya.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: Umunwe 2 we-B owehlisiwe usuvele ubambe u-D entanjeni 3, i-fret 2. Umculo udlula phakathi kwe-chord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · lesson uke-9-4 “Melody inside the chord” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Ama-chord adlalwa ngenothi ngalinye phakathi kwamavesi, nomculo phakathi kwama-chord. Umculo owehubo i-New Britain, elashicilelwa ngo-1829, unamagama ka-John Newton.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 2 (along) · title

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Kungani ibha yokugcina yesingeniso iphela ngenothi elide?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction

Ukulele · Unit 9 · song uke-9-5 “Amazing Grace, fingerpicked” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: Ivesi liqala kusasele isigqi esisodwa, ngamanothi alo e-pickup. Inothi lokugcina elide ligcina leso sigqi sinesikhala.

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Akukho okusha: umunwe wentambo ngayinye, iphethini ephumayo ibuye, isithupha esishintshana nomculo phakathi kwe-chord.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 9 · challenge uke-9-6 “Challenge: fingerpicking” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Isithupha, owokukhomba, ophakathi nowendandatho badlala ziphi izintambo?

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Izingoma ezine ezingenamalungelo obunikazi ezihlelwe ze-ukulele, nendlela yokuhola abantu ekuziculeni.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 “Campfire to stage” · unit summary
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: I-Down by the Riverside, eyashicilelwa okokuqala ngo-1918, yenzelwe ukuculwa ndawonye. Ku-ukulele iku-G, ino-G, C no-D7, kanye no-A ophakanyisiwe wesitayela se-gospel entanjeni 1, i-fret 1.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: Down by the riverside: B, B, A ophakanyisiwe, B, bese A no-G.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-1 “Down by the Riverside” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: U-Cecil Sharp washicilela le ballad yaseNgilandi ngo-1906. Ku-F isebenzisa F, B owehlisiwe, C no-C7, G minor no-D minor, ngokuvamile amabili kubha. Dlala ama-chord ngeminwe phakathi kwamavesi, uwadedele akhale.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: The water is wide: intambo 3 evulekile, F ku-fret 1 kabili, G ku-fret 3, bese A ovulekile.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · title

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Amabha amaningi lapha ashintsha phakathi. Bala ivesi ngohhafu bezigqi ezimbili, i-chord eyodwa ngakunye, ushintshe njalo ngemva kokuchofoza okubili.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-2 “The Water Is Wide” · step 4 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Ngaphambi kokushaya kokuqala, bala kuzwakale nge-tempo yengoma: kunye, kubili, kuthathu, kune. Bonke baqala ndawonye, ngejubane olibekile.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · title

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Weqwe yi-chord? Qhubeka ushaye izintambo, ubambe elandelayo. Abantu abaculayo balandela isigqi, hhayi inothi ngalinye.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 3 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Uphambanisa ukushintsha phakathi nengoma. Wenzenjani manje?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Isigqi sihola bonke. Yeqa i-chord uma kudingeka, kodwa ungalokothi ulahle isigqi.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer
Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · title

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Ngaphambi komugqa wokugcina, nqekuzisa ikhanda noma umemeze uthi okokugcina. Yehlisa ijubane kancane emgqeni wokugcina, uyeke i-chord yokugcina ikhale.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · lesson uke-10-3 “Lead the singalong” · step 6 (explain) · lesson card text
Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: I-Molly Malone yashicilelwa ngo-1876. Iyi-waltz: gcizelela isigqi 1, umculo udansise. Ku-F isebenzisa F, G minor, C7, D minor no-G7.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: In Dublin's fair city: intambo 3 evulekile, F ku-fret 1 kane, A ovulekile, bese ubuyela ku-F.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Iyiphi i-chord edonsela kakhulu emuva ku-F?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: U-C7 uyi-chord engu-V ku-F. Inothi lakhe lesikhombisa lidonsela ngqo ekhaya.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-4 “Molly Malone” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Le ngoma yokugwedla inesigqi sesithupha phezu kwesishiyagalombili: ukubala okuyisithupha okusheshayo kubha, kuzwakale njengokunyakaza okubili okukhulu. Bala u-1 2 3, 4 5 6, ugcizelele u-1 no-4.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Esigqini sesithupha phezu kwesishiyagalombili, izigqi ezinkulu zifika kuphi?
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Ama-quaver ayisithupha aqoqwa kabili ngamathathu: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Elokuqala eqoqweni ngalinye lihola ukunyakaza.
rows.context: Ukulele · Unit 10 · song uke-10-5 “The Skye Boat Song” · step 6 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.translation: Akukho okusha: izingoma ezine, uzibalele uqale, uqhubeke, uphethe kahle. Zidlale zilandelana njengekhonsathi emfushane.

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Yazi u-E A D G, uncinze ngeminwe emibili, udlale amanothi akho okuqala nengoma.

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Intambo ewugqinsi kakhulu inomsindo ophansi kakhulu. Iseduze kakhulu nobuso lapho udlala. Siyibiza ngokuthi intambo 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Izintambo zibalwa kusuka kwencane kakhulu (1) kuya kwewugqinsi kakhulu (4).
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-1 “Meet your bass” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Kusuka kwewugqinsi kuya kwencane: E, A, D, G. Zifana nezintambo ezine eziphansi zesiginci, kodwa ziphansi nge-octave. Khumbula ngezinhlamvu zokuqala: Every Amp Drives Grooves.

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Ncinza ngezingxenye ezithambile zomunwe wokukhomba nophakathi, ngokushintshana. Sekela isithupha ku-pickup noma entanjeni 4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text
Bass · Unit 1 · lesson bass-1-3 “Plucking with two fingers” · step 2 (explain) · title

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Ncinza udlule entanjeni, hhayi uyidonsele phezulu kude. Umunwe ufika uphumule entanjeni elandelayo ewugqinsi. Lokhu kuncinza ngokusekela kukhipha umsindo ogcwele nonamandla.

rows.source: In the air above the strings

rows.source: Pulling through to the next string keeps the motion small and the tone strong.
rows.translation: Ukudonsa udlulele entanjeni elandelayo kugcina ukunyakaza kukuncane nomsindo unamandla.

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: I-Mary Had a Little Lamb idinga amanothi amathathu: B ku-fret 2 wentambo 3, A ovulekile, no-G ku-fret 3 wentambo 4. Umunwe wesibili ku-B, owesithathu ku-G.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: Intambo 3, i-fret 2, umunwe wesibili. Lowo ngu-B.

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: intambo 3, bese G entanjeni 4.

rows.translation: Dlala inothi eliyisisekelo le-chord ngayinye, uqondane nesigqi.

rows.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
rows.translation: I-chord ngayinye yakhelwa phezu kwenothi elilodwa, isisekelo sayo. Isisekelo se-chord ka-A ngu-A. Abadlali bebhesi badlala amanothi ayisisekelo ukuze ibhendi yazi ukuthi ikhaya likuphi.

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: Isisekelo noma cha? Lalela inothi eliphansi kakhulu.

rows.source: A rest is a beat of silence. Stop the string by touching it lightly with a free finger, so the rest is as clean as the note.
rows.translation: Isikhawu yisigqi sokuthula. Misa intambo ngokuyithinta kancane ngomunwe okhululekile, ukuze isikhawu sicace njengenothi.

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.translation: Umunwe ngamunye unakekele i-fret eyodwa: owokukhomba ku-2, ophakathi ku-3, owendandatho ku-4, omncane ku-5. Isithupha sisekela ngemuva kwentamo, maqondana nomunwe ophakathi.

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.translation: Qala ku-G, i-fret 3 wentambo 4, ngomunwe ophakathi. Khuphuka udlule ezintanjeni ezintathu: G A B C D E F ophakanyisiwe G. Lesi simo sisebenza kunoma yiliphi inothi eliyisisekelo.

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.translation: Ophakathi, omncane; bese owokukhomba nophakathi entanjeni 3.

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.translation: Umunwe omncane; bese owokukhomba, owendandatho nomncane entanjeni 2.

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Esigqini 4, dlala inothi eliqhele nge-fret eyodwa esisekelweni esilandelayo. Lidonsela ukulalela phambili, ukushintsha kuzwakale sengathi kufikile lapho bekulindelwe khona.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: I-fret 4 wentambo 3, bese intambo 2 evulekile: i-fret eyodwa phezulu kuya ku-D.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: Uya ku-D kubha elandelayo. Yiliphi inothi esigqini 4 elidonsela kahle khona?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: U-C ophakanyisiwe uphansi nge-fret eyodwa kuno-D. Uhhafu wethoni ushelela ungene ngqo esisekelweni esisha.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · lesson bass-5-3 “Chromatic approach notes” · step 3 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Amabha 12 afanayo, manje anomugqa ohambayo. Amabha aholela ku-chord entsha aphela ngenothi elisondela kuyo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: Ibha 12 ibuyisela isakhiwo ekuqaleni. U-G ophakanyisiwe uphansi nge-fret eyodwa kuno-A, i-chord eqala umjikelezo olandelayo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · song bass-5-4 “Walking the blues in A” · step 5 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: I-blues yamabha 12 isebenza kunoma yimuphi ukhiye. Ku-E, ama-chord angu-E, A no-B. Hamba ngesisekelo, elesithathu, elesihlanu nelesithupha, usondele ekushintsheni ngakunye.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Kukhiye ka-E, iyiphi i-chord efika kubha 9?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 2 (quiz) · question or instruction

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: I-fret 2 wentambo 3; ama-fret 1 no-4 entambo 2; i-fret 1 wentambo 1.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 5 · challenge bass-5-5 “Challenge: walking blues in E” · step 3 (notes) · hint under an exercise

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: I-rock ngama-quaver, izigqi ezinamanothi anamachashazi, izikhala nomugqa wesitayela se-Motown.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 “Grooves” · unit summary

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Bala u-1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Dlala inothi ekubaleni ngakunye, iminwe ishintshane. Inhloso amandla omsindo alinganayo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Ama-quaver akho aqala ukugijima. Yini engasiza?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-1 “Eighth-note rock groove” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Inothi eliyikota elinechashazi lihlala isigqi esisodwa nohhafu. Dlala ku-1, ulibambe kudlule u-2, bese udlala ku-and ka-2, bese ku-3 no-4.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-2 “Dotted rhythms” · step 3 (along) · title

rows.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
rows.translation: Inothi eliyikota elinechashazi lihlala isikhathi esingakanani?

rows.source: Silence is part of the groove
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Amanothi amafushane anezikhawu ezicacile adansisa umugqa. Xegisa umunwe ocindezelayo kodwa uhlale uthinta intambo, ukuze umise inothi ngalinye ngesikhathi esifanele.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · question or instruction
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Yeka ukucindezela umunwe usahleli entanjeni. Inothi liyama ngaphandle kokukhenceza.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-3 “Leave some space” · step 4 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Imigqa yebhesi yenkathi ye-Motown yayinyakaza kakhulu: amanothi e-chord, amanothi adonsela ku-chord elandelayo nokugcizelela phakathi kwezigqi. Lo mugqa musha, uqanjwe ngalowo moya.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Ibha yokuqala: C, E, G, bese B owehlisiwe edonsela ku-A.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 2 (notes) · hint under an exercise
Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 6 (along) · title

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A

Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · quiz answer

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: Uyinothi elisondelayo, i-fret eyodwa ngaphezu kuka-A, isisekelo se-chord elandelayo. Ushelelisa uye kubha elandelayo.
rows.context: Bass · Unit 6 · lesson bass-6-4 “A Motown-style line” · step 7 (quiz) · explanation after a quiz answer

Bass · Unit 6 · challenge bass-6-5 “Challenge: groove set” · step 1 (explain) · title

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Ama-quaver, izigqi zamanothi anamachashazi nomugqa ohambayo. Landela ukuchofoza, iminwe ishintshane, ujabulele isigqi.
